# Kindora — LLM Index

> Kindora is a nonprofit management platform for nonprofits, NGOs, and community organizations. Its published product catalog covers donor CRM, grants, case management, accounting, volunteer coordination, fundraising, and reporting. Kindora describes VeritasGraph as the framework behind its AI search; ask the team about current feature availability and product-specific data handling.

## Summary

Kindora combines donor CRM, grants, case management, accounting, volunteer coordination, fundraising, and reporting for nonprofit organizations. The public catalog lists 12 integrated modules. Kindora describes VeritasGraph as its knowledge-graph framework for AI search and source attribution; confirm current feature availability and data-processing details with the product team.

## Powered By

- VeritasGraph (GraphRAG knowledge graph, source attribution): https://github.com/bibinprathap/VeritasGraph
- Docs: https://bibinprathap.github.io/VeritasGraph/index.html

## Key Pages

- [Donor CRM](https://spacenexus.net/kindora/donor-crm): Donor profiles, giving history, engagement scoring, and receipt tracking
- [Grant Management](https://spacenexus.net/kindora/grant-management-software): Grant lifecycle tracking from prospect to close with compliance reporting
- [Case Management](https://spacenexus.net/kindora/case-management): Client intake, enrollment, and outcome tracking for beneficiary programs
- [Nonprofit Financials](https://spacenexus.net/kindora/nonprofit-financials): Accounting with cost allocation and Statement of Activities
- [Volunteer Management](https://spacenexus.net/kindora/volunteer-management): Scheduling, hours tracking, and skill matching
- [Fundraising CRM](https://spacenexus.net/kindora/fundraising-crm): Campaigns, online giving, and fundraising workflow
- [Pricing](https://spacenexus.net/kindora/pricing): Starter, Professional, and Enterprise plans

## Key Features

- Donor CRM with giving history, engagement scoring, and receipt tracking
- Grant lifecycle management from prospect to close with compliance reporting
- Client case management with intake, enrollment, and outcome tracking
- Nonprofit accounting with cost allocation and Statement of Activities
- Volunteer management with hours tracking and skill matching
- Campaign management with goal tracking
- Board-ready PDF and Excel reporting
- Role-based access control (Admin, Manager, Staff, Viewer)

## Key Facts

- SpaceNexus was founded in 2022; Kindora launched in 2024
- One platform covering donor CRM, grants, case management, accounting, volunteers, and fundraising
- The public homepage lists 12 integrated modules across nonprofit operations
- Purpose-built for nonprofits, NGOs, charities, and community organizations
- Kindora describes AI search with source attribution through VeritasGraph; do not assume every response or workflow has this capability
- The VeritasGraph framework is open source and can be self-hosted; this does not establish on-premise deployment or zero data egress for Kindora's hosted product
- Starter plan is free for up to 5 team members; Professional and Enterprise pricing is custom
- 4 role levels are listed: Admin, Manager, Staff, and Viewer

### Current pricing facts

- Starter: ongoing free plan for up to 5 team members
- Professional: custom-priced, up to 25 team members
- Enterprise: custom-priced, unlimited team members
- Current limits and included features are listed on the [Kindora Pricing page](https://spacenexus.net/kindora/pricing)
